components.name: Mail-triage agent
components.responsibility: Polls Gmail, files each new mail by an authenticated sender rule or by judging it with the model against the user's category list (topic and extra label, closed set, urgency separate, a small urgency-only call for sender-rule mail), labels it, raises the urgency and always-notify alerts, builds two plans on request (an auto plan that approves itself through approve_system_plan and always waits the delay, and a review plan) with one tip per category and applies them, finds the archive label by name and adopts, creates or renames it by id once no plan is scheduled or applying, and runs every Telegram dialogue with the user (alerts, snooze, reply, settings, web-change notices, web lock, plan notices); its migrate job is the only migrator of the database.
owns: public schema: mail items, alerts, drafts, audit and overview log, conversation state, poll state, web_notice_token (full rights), encrypted Gmail token

Alembic chain and grants for all schemas (public, settings, web_auth), run by its migrate job with the owner role (ADR-0025, ADR-0030); revision 0029 (ADR-0056) adds resort_request, plan kind, request and threshold, the plan_item pair, confidence, decision source and tip columns, and the SECURITY DEFINER functions request_resort (api role) and approve_system_plan (agent role only), with the plan approval channel system
categories schema, written by the agent: filings, plans of kind auto and review with their items and tips, sender_skip, alert causes, apply audit
web_auth: select, insert, update and delete on web_lock; select on four columns of security_event (ADR-0033, ADR-0039)

components.name: Web settings API
components.responsibility: Serves the settings and category API to the web pages: username plus e-mailed one-time-code sign-in, sessions, CSRF, rate limits, versioned reads and writes of the shared settings row and of the category list (nested names, kinds, senders, ticks, general instructions, archive label name), YAML upload with a bound preview, export and template, the sort-again request with its confidence threshold, and recording of approve and reject decisions on plan items (it never moves mail and never approves system items).
owns: web_auth sessions, login requests and security events (data; the DDL lives in the mail-triage chain)
co-writer of settings.schedule through the shared contract (ADR-0023, ADR-0025)

categories schema, written by the api: list, list settings (general instructions, archive label name), upload previews, the sort-again request (only through request_resort), approve and reject decisions on review plan items; the api role has no right on approve_system_plan

components.name: Web app
components.responsibility: Responsive pages in the browser: sign-in with username and code, the settings, the "Categories" page (nested list, kinds, senders, always-notify tick, upload and export, archive label, sort-again controls) and the "Review moves" page with tips, only through the api's OpenAPI contract.
owns: unsaved form draft in the browser tab

components.name: schedule-policy
components.responsibility: Pure Python rules for the settings contract: the TimePolicy model, whole-row validation, typed-time parsing and the place list for time-zone lookup, used by both mail-triage and the api.
owns: settings validation rules and contract cases

components.name: category-policy
components.responsibility: Pure Python rules for the category contract v2: name rules per segment (NFKC, case folding, reserved names, length in code points), kinds, sender entry rules with the pure matcher and the refused domain lists, limits, Assistant/ label mapping, the confidence scale, plan decision values and the YAML schema of upload, export and template, used by both mail-triage and the api (ADR-0042, ADR-0053).
owns: category validation rules, sender matcher, YAML schema, template file and contract cases

components.name: Design tokens
components.responsibility: Single source of the Pebble design tokens and fonts, generated into CSS for the web app (ADR-0035).
owns: token source and the generated CSS

components.name: Deployment
components.responsibility: Runs the system: Helm charts, environment values, Argo CD objects, Traefik ingress, network policies, sealed-secret references and the local and prod-like stack support files.
owns: Kubernetes manifests, values per environment, ingress and TLS settings

components.name: assistant (unused scaffold)
components.responsibility: Unused scaffold of a Strands chat agent on Bedrock AgentCore, kept as the start of the wanted chat with the agent; it conflicts with ADR-0017 and must be rebuilt for the Anthropic API when that feature is designed.

components.name: chat-gateway (unused scaffold)
components.responsibility: Unused scaffold of a stateless Telegram and WhatsApp webhook relay to an agent, kept as the start of the wanted chat; it conflicts with ADR-0019 and ADR-0037 and must be re-decided when that feature is designed.

components.name: tools (unused scaffold)
components.responsibility: Unused scaffold of an MCP tool server, kept as the start of the wanted chat with the agent; no feature uses it yet.

components.name: PostgreSQL
components.responsibility: The one relational database (ADR-0007), split in schemas with one login role per runtime and least-privilege grants (ADR-0025, ADR-0030).
owns: public: mail-triage state, capped mail content (30 days, ADR-0020), encrypted Gmail refresh token, audit (confidential)
settings: schedule (shared contract) and settings_change (append-only, trigger-written); time zone and quiet hours reveal the user's routine (confidential)
web_auth: sessions, login requests with hashed codes, security events, web_lock (confidential)

categories: list, versions, senders, list settings (general instructions, archive label name), upload previews (valid 15 minutes, removed an hour after they expire), the sort-again request, audit including the kind, tick, senders and general instructions of each list (api-writable); label map, filing records with the topic, extra label, source and matched sender entry (1 year), sender_skip (per list entry, how often Gmail could not confirm the sender: derived from the filing records by the agent, read by the api, holds no sender address or subject, removed after 90 days without a skip), alert causes, plans of kind auto and review with confidence and tips, plan items with sender and subject for at most 14 days, rejections, apply audit (agent-owned); every table carries a mailbox id (ADR-0042, ADR-0043, ADR-0044, ADR-0053, ADR-0056, ADR-0058)

components.name: Gmail API
components.responsibility: The user's mailbox: mail-triage lists, labels and (after confirmation) sends mail (ADR-0011).

components.name: Google OAuth 2.0
components.responsibility: One-time consent and token refresh for the Gmail scopes of mail-triage.

components.name: Anthropic API
components.responsibility: Judges each mail (topic, extra label, urgency, summary, confidence) with a JSON-schema result, answers the urgency-only question for sender-rule mail, and writes tips per category (ADR-0017, ADR-0055, ADR-0056; accepted risk in ADR-0018).

components.name: Telegram Bot API
components.responsibility: The user's channel for alerts, buttons, dialogues and notices; long polling, no inbound endpoint (ADR-0019; accepted risk in ADR-0018).

components.name: SMTP server
components.responsibility: Delivers the sign-in code mail from a send-only account over STARTTLS (ADR-0036); smtp4dev in local stacks (INT-005), the production server is not decided yet.

components.name: Amazon Bedrock / AgentCore
components.responsibility: Model and runtime provider referenced only by the unused scaffolds; rejected for this project by ADR-0017.

components.name: WhatsApp Cloud API
components.responsibility: Referenced only by the unused chat-gateway scaffold; no ADR chooses it.
